what_happened: Three-source enumeration landed cleanly: PlusLanguage 268 decls over 18 files, OpenLanguage 195 over 10, theorem-index 17 PlusLanguage-cited rows / 43 L-plus-mentioning rows, Metalogic README TM-plus table 10 content rows. Task 856's plan phase table gave the exact landed/owed split for the Open proof system without re-derivation.

lean_local_search returned index: warming, so LSP-backed absence is not proof of absence. Evidence of record for every negative existence claim in the ledger is a recorded grep over FormalSystem/**/*.lean, announced as such in the report.

The research report's own Verification Commands section and per-recommendation scopes supplied the plan's phase content almost verbatim, so planning needed no re-exploration of the tree; the only genuinely new planning work was resolving how a report-only task's conclusion stage can discharge Component 4b without tripping Component 7's mandatory foreground confirmation.

The dispatch defers task filing to 'the conclusion stage', but the Multi-Task Creation Standard's Component 7 makes user confirmation mandatory and foreground-only, so no autonomous implement dispatch can file the recommended tasks. The plan resolves this by having the implement phase render a reconciled proposal packet plus issues.jsonl follow_up_task entries instead of filing, leaving the Component 7 decision with the user.

Reproducibility audit found the report's direct-embedding block undercounted the Star-side ofPlus(ofFormula) hit count: asserted 9, correct value at the report's own pin (4c52993c1) and at every committed state checked is 16. The 3 contributing files are byte-identical since the report's pin, so this is an authoring-time defect, not tree movement. Corrected in the report body and recorded in the new Reproducibility Audit section.

Every other command block in the report's Verification Commands section reproduced exactly against the committed tree: Source A, Source B, Source C, the unformalized-hypotheses block, the reduction-vehicle signatures, and the stale-surface block. No LSP index was available for this re-run either (same degraded-tooling tier as the original research dispatch); all reproduction was by re-running the recorded grep/sed/awk commands and diffing against the inline comments.

Tree movement observed live during this audit (task 856 phases 13 and 15 landing, uncommitted-then-committed, in the exact files this report's R50 row and stale-surface finding named) independently confirms the ledger's OWED-row ownership table pointed at the right next steps. R50's target file (Conservativity/Open/Forward.lean) and the stale OpenLanguage/README.md claim were both actively being discharged by task 856 while this audit ran. Not absorbed into the ledger's row-status table per Phase 1's non-goal against re-adjudicating row status; recorded for Phase 2/3 and the conclusion stage.

While drafting Phase 2's proposal packet, discovered a LIVE, uncommitted edit to specs/state.json (last_updated 2026-11-05T18:21:07Z, concurrent with this dispatch) adding a 'PRIORITY RULING (2026-11-05, user): DEMOTED' annotation to tasks 860, 869, 873, 874, 875, 876: the L^▷ transfer programme is now a secondary line of investigation behind L-plus completeness/decidability, and none of those tasks may be dispatched ahead of or batched with L-plus critical-path work. specs/ROADMAP.md (committed, clean) still states 'The aim is completeness and decidability of L^▷' -- stale relative to this live ruling. Task 872 itself (this ledger task) carries no such annotation. Since Phase 2 renders T1-T5, all extensions of the same L^▷ transfer programme, this is surfaced prominently in proposals.md and flagged via user_decision rather than silently filing recommendations against the user's just-stated live priority.

The live, uncommitted priority-demotion edit observed earlier during Phase 2 (specs/state.json, 18:21:07Z) landed as a committed, stable fact before this dispatch finished Phase 2: specs/ROADMAP.md commit d863cb374 'roadmap: refocus on L-plus, demote L^open to exploration'. proposals.md's callout was updated to cite the committed commit rather than describe it as a transient/uncommitted observation.

T1 (proposals.json id open_state_locality_fragment): the L^▷ state-locality fragment has no counterpart of FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/PlusStateLocal.lean. Highest-value unowned gap (R41, R62) -- the decidability front's one working anchor for the stability modal.

T2 (proposals.json id open_semantics_support_lemmas): small L^▷ semantics-support lemmas (R28, R32, R60, R61, optionally R42) have no counterpart of several FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/ validity/reversal/truth support lemmas.

T3 (proposals.json id open_axiom_set_nonredundancy): OpenAxiom (71 constructors) has no non-redundancy result covering its 18 new schemata, unlike PlusAxiom's (53) plusAxiomSetNonRedundant. Gated on task 856 closing (phase 15 in progress).

T4 (proposals.json id open_direct_embedding_of_tm_into_open): the direct L-to-L^▷ embedding has no named declaration anywhere, counterpart of FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/Formula.lean's ofFormula (the embedding of L into L-plus). Five ledger rows depend on it.

T5 (proposals.json id open_future_undefinable_hmarkers_specialization): ofut_not_plusDefinable_of_deltaProp_inexpressible's hmarkers hypothesis cannot yet be specialized to an application, since task 860 (its prerequisite bridge lemma) is only researched, not implemented.

Ordering hazard: T4 (direct L-to-L^▷ embedding) must be sequenced before tasks 873 and 874, both of which declare FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/Formula.lean in their own file_scope and have not started. (Corrected from the report's original framing, which named task 856 phase 13 as the thing T4 must precede -- phase 13 landed, committed e3392ff51, during this ledger task's own Phase 1 audit, using the unnamed composite rather than T4's proposed name, so that specific edge is now moot.)

Ordering hazard: T2 (L^▷ semantics-support lemmas) shares FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/ and FormalSystem/Semantics/ territory with task 869 (open modal invariance ray agreement lifting, [NOT STARTED]) -- both touch the same OpenTruthAt-style recursion. Must be batched with it or given an explicit dependency edge, never dispatched concurrently.

FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/README.md states 'L^▷ is semantic only: it has no proof system' and lists six files against nine on disk; FormalSystem/Metalogic/Conservativity/Open.lean's docstring is accurate and the two surfaces disagree. Owned by task 856 phase 15 ('ledger surfaces and the full gate'), observed actively in progress (uncommitted) during this audit already rewriting this exact claim -- do not propose a duplicate task.

FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/README.md's generated inventory row for Subformulas.lean reads '<!-- TODO: add description -->'. Low-severity, cosmetic; recorded here rather than silently dropped. No proposal filed for it -- too small to carry its own task; a natural pickup is whichever task next regenerates that README's inventory block (e.g. task 873, which already touches FormalSystem/OpenLanguage.lean and runs check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory).

Final observation at Phase 3 close: task 856 (the L^▷ proof-system task) completed all 15 of its plan phases, committed, entirely during this ledger task's own implement dispatch (commits e3392ff51 through 5d741bc8c). This fully resolves the stale-surface finding (OpenLanguage/README.md's 'semantic only' claim is now gone, inventory lists all 9 files) and satisfies T3's hard gate (sequenced after task 856 closes). Not re-opened or re-audited here -- Phase 1's audit and Phase 2's packet already captured the state as it stood at the time each was written; this is recorded as a closing coda, not a revision.
